cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,json,subprocess,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,datagram,trace
N=500000
# first range: largest=2*N, first=0 => [2N,2N]
body=bytearray(b'\x02'); body+=v(2*N)+v(0)+v(N-1)+v(0)
for i in range(N-1):
    body+=b'\x00\x00'  # gap0 range0
print('body',len(body))
tr=trace([datagram(envelope('I',0,bytes(body)),(0,))])
inp=json.dumps({'traces':[tr]})
start=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=inp.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=180)
print('elapsed',time.time()-start,'rc',p.returncode,'outlen',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:500])
if p.returncode==0:
 o=json.loads(p.stdout)['traces'][0]
 print(o['packets'][0]['status'],o['acknowledged'][0]['count'],o['acknowledged'][0]['intervals'],o['acknowledged'][0]['prefix'])
PY
